subject: general
question: In a two stroke petrol engine, during the upward stroke of the piston, the gases are compressed in the piston, and at the same time, which of the following is also performed during the operation?

options.text: Fresh air and fuel (petrol) mixture enters the crank chamber through the valve.
Fresh air for petrol engine enters the cylinder from the chamber through the valve exhaust port.
Exhaust gases enter the crank chamber through the valve.
Fresh fuel enters in the cylinder from the crank chamber through the valve.

solution:
The correct answer is __Fresh air and fuel (petrol) mixture enters the crank chamber through the valve**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Two-stroke petrol engines__ perform all their cycles (intake, compression, power, and exhaust) in just two strokes of the piston.
 
• During the upward stroke of the piston, the gases are compressed in the cylinder.
 
• At the same time, fresh air and fuel mixture enter the crank chamber through the inlet valve due to the partial vacuum created.
 
• This simultaneous action enhances the engine's efficiency and compactness.
 
• The design of a two-stroke engine ensures efficient fuel intake while preparing for the next power stroke.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Two-Stroke Engine Operations:**
 
 
• The upward stroke compresses the fuel-air mixture in the cylinder while simultaneously allowing fresh fuel-air to enter the crankcase.
 
• The downward stroke ignites the compressed mixture, producing power and expelling exhaust gases.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Two-Stroke Engines:**
 
 
• Compact and lightweight design.
 
• Higher power-to-weight ratio compared to four-stroke engines.
 
• Simple mechanical structure with fewer moving parts.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used in motorcycles, scooters, chainsaws, and small boats due to their compact size and efficiency.
